int.name: rami_b2b_minimum_order_quantity
int.label: Minimum order quantity
Mindestbestellmenge
int.help-text: Leave empty to allow any positive quantity.
Leer lassen, um jede positive Menge zu erlauben.

int.name: rami_b2b_order_quantity_step
int.label: Order quantity multiple
Bestellmengen-Schritt
int.help-text: Leave empty for no multiple restriction. For example, 6 means quantities must be 6, 12, 18, and so on.
Leer lassen, wenn keine Mengenschritte gelten. Beispiel: 6 bedeutet 6, 12, 18 usw.
